A pressure reducing valve is normally installed on the hot outlet of the water heater, upstream of the relief valve tapping.
A pressure reducing valve is normally installed on each fixture supply stop, upstream of the flexible connector to the faucet.
A pressure reducing valve is normally installed on the irrigation branch only, upstream of the vacuum breaker assembly.

questions.explanation: Placing the valve at the entry protects the whole building system evenly. Access for adjustment and service must be preserved after installation.

questions.question: A colleague at the plumbing shop asks Marcus about trap arm function. Which guidance is correct?

answers.text: The trap arm carries sewer gas from the drainage piping into the trap and must slope upward toward the fixture tailpiece.
The trap arm carries supply water from the vent connection back to the trap inlet and must slope toward the fixture.
The trap arm carries discharge from the trap outlet to the vent connection and must slope toward the drainage piping.
The trap arm carries vent air into the waste stream under pressure and must be installed without any slope at all.

questions.explanation: The trap arm links trap and vent while draining the fixture. Its length and slope affect seal protection.

questions.question: While preparing at the contractor office, James reviews accessible unions and fittings. Which statement applies?

answers.text: Accessibility of fittings matters only for water piping, since gas joints are expected to be permanent and untouched.
Concealed unions are acceptable when extra compound is used, because compound guarantees the joint for the building life. This idea supports consistent decisions across the whole team.
Unions and service fittings in gas piping must remain accessible for maintenance and may not be concealed within walls, floors, or other inaccessible construction.
Unions in gas piping may be buried inside sealed walls because a properly made union will never need service again.

questions.explanation: Every mechanical joint is a potential service point. Accessibility allows inspection and repair without demolition.

questions.question: Elena is handling a matter involving system drainage planning while documenting a job problem. Which statement should guide the work?

answers.text: Supply piping should be arranged so no section can ever be drained down, keeping water trapped in every low pocket permanently.
Supply piping should be arranged so the whole system, or each isolated section, can be drained down in a controlled manner.
Supply piping should be arranged so the whole system drains into wall cavities, keeping floors dry during any repair work.
Supply piping should be arranged so drainage happens through fixture faucets only, with no regard for trapped sections below.

questions.explanation: Planning for drainage is part of maintainable design. Air admitted at high points lets water leave freely at low points.

questions.question: While helping an apprentice understand the material, Hannah explains grease interceptor purpose. Which statement is accurate?

answers.text: A grease interceptor pressurizes kitchen drainage so fats and oils harden and can be stored permanently inside downstream piping.
A grease interceptor heats kitchen drainage so fats and oils dissolve and can be flushed quickly into downstream piping.
A grease interceptor filters kitchen drainage so fats and oils emulsify and can be discharged freely into downstream piping.
A grease interceptor slows kitchen drainage so fats and oils separate and can be removed before they clog downstream piping.

questions.explanation: Separation protects sewers from grease buildup. Regular removal of collected grease keeps the device effective.

questions.question: Before the team meeting, Sofia tests the handling of board disciplinary power. Which statement shows the right grasp?

answers.text: The board may investigate complaints and discipline a licensee who violates Idaho plumbing law, board rules, or the adopted plumbing code.
The board may discipline a licensee only for late paperwork and never for unsafe work that violates the adopted plumbing code.
The board may investigate complaints only when a local building official personally requests an investigation in a public hearing. Teams come back to this idea when practice questions arise.
The board may investigate complaints but lacks any power to discipline a licensee even after a proven violation of plumbing law.

questions.explanation: Disciplinary authority allows the board to address violations directly. That power supports consistent enforcement across the state.

questions.question: During work at the mechanical room, a question turns on flexible connector limitations. Which statement is correct?

answers.text: Flexible connectors serve only the appliance they connect, must not be reused after appliance replacement in sound practice, and must stay visible and protected from damage.
Reusing an old connector on a new appliance is preferred because a connector that held gas once is proven forever after.
Flexible connectors may be concealed inside the appliance cabinet walls where foot traffic and storage cannot reach them.
A flexible connector may serve as permanent building piping through several rooms when rigid pipe is difficult to install. This is standard knowledge for experienced plumbing professionals.

questions.explanation: Connectors are appliance accessories, not building piping. Visible, protected, and renewed installation keeps them reliable.

questions.question: In everyday plumbing work, sealing fixture to floor often shapes the quality of an installation or a bid. Which statement about it is correct?

answers.text: A water closet base is sealed at the tank contact to help keep flush water and supply water from migrating over the fixture and into the bowl rim.

A water closet base is sealed at the ceiling contact to help keep vent air and rain water from migrating under the fixture and into the floor below. Practitioners return to this point whenever installation quality is reviewed.
A water closet base is sealed at the floor contact to help keep spilled water and cleaning water from migrating under the fixture and into the floor.
A water closet base is sealed at the floor contact to help keep sewer gas flowing freely from migrating under the fixture and into the floor drain.

questions.explanation: Sealing the base perimeter limits moisture intrusion while the flange bolts and wax or gasket provide the drain seal itself.

questions.question: Alicia is working during a team knowledge check and must apply the knowledge on backflow on fixture outlets. Which statement gives the correct guidance?

answers.text: Fixture outlets that can be submerged, such as a hose or handheld spray, need only a screen for protection so used water is filtered back into the potable supply.
Fixture outlets that can be submerged, such as a hose or handheld spray, need backflow protection so used water cannot be drawn back into the potable supply.
Fixture outlets that can be submerged, such as a hose or handheld spray, need extra backflow promotion so used water can flow faster into the potable supply.
Fixture outlets that can be submerged, such as a hose or handheld spray, need no backflow protection so used water can be drawn back into the potable supply.

questions.explanation: Negative pressure in the supply can pull contaminated water backward, and approved devices or air gaps guard against it.

questions.question: Something needs attention while mentoring a registered apprentice, and protecting fixtures during construction is at the center of it. Which statement points the right way?

answers.text: Fixtures set before other trades finish are uncovered and unprotected so finishes, seats and working parts are exposed to debris, tools and traffic. The point comes up in training for new plumbing apprentices.
Fixtures set before other trades finish are removed and discarded so finishes, seats and working parts are not damaged by storage or handling.
Fixtures set before other trades finish are covered and protected so finishes, seats and working parts are not damaged by debris, tools or construction traffic.
Fixtures set before other trades finish are filled with mortar so finishes, seats and working parts are not damaged by water testing or use.

questions.explanation: A fixture damaged before turnover becomes a callback and a warranty argument. Simple covers and care during the finishing stages protect the installation the customer paid for.

questions.question: When a situation involving renewal and continuing competence needs resolving while preparing for an examination review session, which statement is correct?

answers.text: Renewal requires the licensee to retake the full initial examination every cycle regardless of experience or competence activities. The point comes up in training for new plumbing apprentices.
Renewal may require the licensee to attest to or complete continuing competence activities that keep trade and code knowledge current.
Renewal and continuing competence are handled entirely by employers, and the individual licensee bears no responsibility at all.
Renewal never involves continuing competence because plumbing codes and trade practices remain unchanged over an entire career.

questions.explanation: Continuing competence keeps knowledge aligned with current codes. Renewal is the checkpoint for that expectation.

new-mexico-mm1-plumbing.quiz_title: New Mexico MM-1 Plumbing Contractor Exam Prep FREE Sample Exam

questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes purpose of slope in a horizontal drain?

answers.text: Slope is needed so the drain can be pressurized by the fixtures discharging into it.
Slope exists mainly to make the pipe easier to support from the structure.
Slope is only a cosmetic preference and a level drain performs the same over time.
Without continuous fall, waste water stalls in the pipe and deposits solids that narrow the bore.

questions.explanation: Gravity is the only engine a drain has, so the grade set at rough-in decides whether the system works for decades or clogs from the start. The statement that holds here is that without continuous fall, waste water stalls in the pipe and deposits solids that narrow the bore.

questions.question: Thinking about a pipe offset drawn on an isometric, which of these statements holds true?

answers.text: Offsets on an isometric are shown only in the plan view and never in the isometric.
An offset changes a vertical stack into a horizontal run permanently.
An offset is drawn by erasing a section of pipe from the isometric.
An offset shifts a run sideways or around an obstruction while keeping it headed in its original direction.

questions.explanation: Fabricating an offset from the drawing instead of improvising it in place keeps alignment true when the run resumes past the obstruction. The statement that holds here is that an offset shifts a run sideways or around an obstruction while keeping it headed in its original direction.

questions.question: When it comes to the required depth of a trap seal, which statement holds up?

answers.text: There is no maximum depth for a trap seal, so deeper is always better.
Trap seal depth is measured along the length of the trap arm.
The seal depth is measured from the water level in the trap down to the dip of the trap.
A trap seal must be deep enough to reach the fixture outlet to work.

questions.explanation: The seal is the only thing between a room and the sewer, and its depth is the margin that everyday disturbances must not exhaust. The statement that holds here is that the seal depth is measured from the water level in the trap down to the dip of the trap.

questions.question: With respect to wet venting of a bathroom group, which statement is correct?

answers.text: In a wet vent, the oversized shared pipe carries waste from an upstream fixture while its upper portion vents the fixtures below.
Wet venting is a defect that must be corrected whenever it is found.
Wet venting allows a water closet to be vented through a kitchen sink drain in another room.
Wet venting lets a single vent serve every fixture in a building regardless of location.

questions.explanation: Done correctly, wet venting saves material and wall space in the most common room in the house without giving up trap protection. The statement that holds here is that in a wet vent, the oversized shared pipe carries waste from an upstream fixture while its upper portion vents the fixtures below.

questions.question: Which of these statements best sums up character of a dual check valve device?

answers.text: A dual check valve device is a testable assembly with test cocks for field verification.
A dual check valve device is approved for high-hazard industrial cross-connections.
A dual check valve device protects against backpressure from toxic chemicals.
On a residential service, a dual check valve device limits reverse flow of ordinary household water into the street main.

questions.explanation: Knowing which devices can be tested and which cannot shapes how much trust an inspector or owner can place in the protection years later. The statement that holds here is that on a residential service, a dual check valve device limits reverse flow of ordinary household water into the street main.

questions.question: This is a foundational item. Which statement about capillary action loss of trap seals is correct?

answers.text: Capillary action refills traps by drawing water up from the drain.
Capillary action can deplete a trap seal when hair, lint, or string draped over the trap weir wicks water out of the trap.
Capillary action only occurs in copper supply tubing and never in a trap.
Capillary action strengthens a trap seal by pulling the water level higher.

questions.explanation: Capillary loss explains seals that fail in fixtures used every day, and it is cured by cleaning rather than by repiping. The statement that holds here is that capillary action can deplete a trap seal when hair, lint, or string draped over the trap weir wicks water out of the trap.

questions.question: A senior specialist is briefing a new hire on insulation of hot water piping. Which explanation is accurate?

answers.text: Insulating a hot line increases the heat it loses to the room.
Insulation must never be used on any water piping indoors.
Insulation makes hot water hotter than the heater setting.
Insulating hot water piping reduces heat loss while the water travels to the fixture.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: The energy saved is modest per foot but constant, and the faster hot water delivery is a comfort benefit occupants notice daily. The statement that holds here is that insulating hot water piping reduces heat loss while the water travels to the fixture.

questions.question: Under the heading of knee clearance under an accessible lavatory, which statement is correct?

answers.text: Knee clearance is measured from the bottom of the supply valves.
Exposed hot water piping under an accessible lavatory needs no protection.
A cabinet under the lavatory is fine as long as the counter height is correct.
That open space lets a wheelchair user roll under the lavatory and reach the faucets instead of leaning in from a distance.

questions.explanation: The space under the fixture is as much a part of the accessible design as the fixture itself, and stored cleaners or bare hot pipes quietly take it away. The statement that holds here is that that open space lets a wheelchair user roll under the lavatory and reach the faucets instead of leaning in from a distance.

questions.question: Keep the level and the task in view. Which statement about daily design flow for an on-site system is correct?

answers.text: Daily design flow is ignored when an absorption field is laid out.
A mansion and a small cottage always require identical absorption fields on the same soil.
Design flow refers to how fast a faucet fills a bathtub.
The absorption field is sized using the daily design flow of the home it serves.

questions.explanation: A field sized for less water than the house produces will fail hydraulically no matter how well it was built. The statement that holds here is that the absorption field is sized using the daily design flow of the home it serves.

questions.question: As a matter of drainage fixture unit load of a clothes washer, which of the following statements is true?

answers.text: A clothes washer is assigned a load of 3 drainage fixture units, the same as a flush-tank water closet.
A clothes washer carries no fixture unit load because a standpipe buffers its discharge.
The clothes washer is the heaviest single load among common household fixtures because its pump empties a full tub quickly.
A clothes washer is assigned a load of 1 drainage fixture unit because it discharges into a standpipe.

questions.explanation: Laundry surges are a classic cause of suds and water backing out of nearby fixtures, and full load counting is the defense at design time. The statement that holds here is that the clothes washer is the heaviest single load among common household fixtures because its pump empties a full tub quickly.

questions.question: Which statement gives the most accurate picture of field layout guided by an isometric drawing?

answers.text: Field layout ignores the isometric once work begins.
Following the isometric in the field keeps installed piping aligned with the design that was sized and checked.
An isometric is used in the field only to cover the work area from dust.
Installers lay out runs from memory because isometrics are kept in the office.

questions.explanation: Laying out from the checked drawing is what makes the installed system the same system that passed analysis on paper. The statement that holds here is that following the isometric in the field keeps installed piping aligned with the design that was sized and checked.

questions.question: Which description of prohibition on reducing a drain in the direction of flow is the soundest?

answers.text: A drain may be reduced in the direction of flow whenever fittings are easier to find in the smaller size.
A drain should be reduced before each bend to increase velocity through the turn.
A drain reduction in the direction of flow is required where a stack meets the building drain.
Pipe size in a drainage run stays the same or increases as fixture load accumulates toward the outlet.

questions.explanation: Solids do not negotiate a shoulder the way water does, and one reduction can make an otherwise correct system chronically unreliable. The statement that holds here is that pipe size in a drainage run stays the same or increases as fixture load accumulates toward the outlet.

questions.question: A senior specialist is briefing a new hire on protecting water piping from freezing. Which explanation is accurate?

answers.text: Drainage piping can never be damaged by freezing.
Locating water lines in an outside wall is the best protection against freezing.
Insulation guarantees a pipe can never freeze no matter how cold the space gets.
Water piping in unheated or exterior locations must be protected against freezing.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: Freeze breaks often appear as floods at thaw, long after the cold night that caused them, so prevention at rough-in is the real fix. The statement that holds here is that water piping in unheated or exterior locations must be protected against freezing.

questions.question: Reason it out step by step. Which statement about air break where a washer discharge hose meets the standpipe is correct?

answers.text: The discharge hose of a clothes washer rests loosely in the standpipe with an air break so drain water can never siphon back into the machine.
A washer discharge hose must be sealed airtight into the standpipe.
The air break at a standpipe is a vacuum breaker threaded onto the hose.
A washer hose pushed deep to the trap gives the best protection.

questions.explanation: That loose fit looks unfinished to a novice, but it is the deliberate break that keeps a drainage backup out of a machine full of clean laundry. The statement that holds here is that the discharge hose of a clothes washer rests loosely in the standpipe with an air break so drain water can never siphon back into the machine.

questions.question: The facts below are the whole basis. Which of the following statements about strainers on roof drains is NOT correct?

answers.text: A missing or crushed roof drain dome leaves the whole drainage path below it exposed to blockage.
Roof drains are fitted with strainers or domes that keep leaves and debris out of the drainage piping.
The strainer on a roof drain lets water pass while stopping the gravel, leaves, and trash that would clog leaders and horizontal drains.
Roof drain strainers are decorative covers with no drainage function.

questions.explanation: Most storm failures start with debris at the drain, so the inexpensive dome protects hundreds of feet of piping below it. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that roof drain strainers are decorative covers with no drainage function.

questions.question: One option fits the principle best. Which statement about using scale and dimensions on a plumbing plan is correct?

answers.text: A distance scaled off a print always overrides the written dimension beside it.
Blueprints are drawn with no scale so any ruler can be used on them.
A plan is drawn to a stated scale, but figured dimensions on the drawing take priority over scaling a distance off the paper.
Written dimensions on a plan are approximate suggestions only.

questions.explanation: Building to the figured dimension keeps rough-in locations matching the fixtures and equipment that were specified for the job. The statement that holds here is that a plan is drawn to a stated scale, but figured dimensions on the drawing take priority over scaling a distance off the paper.

questions.question: During a team talk, the topic of sizing a grease interceptor comes up. Which statement by the lead specialist is accurate?

answers.text: A grease interceptor is sized by the height of the building it serves.
A grease interceptor is sized by the flow it must handle and the grease storage it must provide between cleanings.
A grease interceptor needs no sizing because one standard unit fits every kitchen.
A grease interceptor is sized only by the diameter of the pipe leaving the building.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: Matching capacity to real kitchen demand is what keeps separation working between service visits instead of failing silently mid-cycle. The statement that holds here is that a grease interceptor is sized by the flow it must handle and the grease storage it must provide between cleanings.

questions.question: This item checks applied understanding. Which of the following statements about protective systems for deep excavations is NOT correct?

answers.text: The protective system guards against a cave-in, which can bury a worker in seconds.
An excavation 5 feet deep needs no protection if the soil looks firm.
An excavation 5 feet deep or more needs a protective system for workers inside it.
Sloping, shoring, or a trench box are the recognized ways to protect workers in a deep excavation.

questions.explanation: Trench cave-ins are among the deadliest plumbing accidents, and the protective system is planned before anyone enters, not after soil moves. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that an excavation 5 feet deep needs no protection if the soil looks firm.

questions.question: Judge each option against the concept. Which of the following statements about shutoff valves downstream of an atmospheric vacuum breaker is NOT correct?

answers.text: Piping served by an atmospheric vacuum breaker must run without a downstream control valve between the breaker and the outlet.
No shutoff valve may be installed downstream of an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
A shutoff valve downstream of an atmospheric vacuum breaker is required for servicing.
A valve downstream of an atmospheric vacuum breaker can hold the device under pressure and defeat the way its air port is meant to work.

questions.explanation: A downstream valve turns a simple siphon breaker into a pressurized fitting it was never built to be, and the failure stays hidden until a siphon event occurs. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that a shutoff valve downstream of an atmospheric vacuum breaker is required for servicing.

questions.question: This item checks applied understanding. Which of the following statements about protection of piping passing through framing is NOT correct?

answers.text: Bored holes must also leave enough wood that the framing keeps its structural strength.
Pipes near a stud edge need no protection because fasteners avoid them.
Water piping passing through studs and plates must be protected from nails and screws with steel plates where it runs close to the edge.
A shield plate stops a drywall fastener from puncturing the pipe behind the finished wall.

questions.explanation: The leak from a nail through a supply line often appears years after the wall is closed, and the plate is the only thing preventing it. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that pipes near a stud edge need no protection because fasteners avoid them.

mississippi-real-estate-broker.quiz_title: Mississippi Real Estate Broker Exam Prep FREE Sample Exam

questions.question: In the area of the four unities required for a joint tenancy, which of the following is accurate?

answers.text: In a joint tenancy, a deceased owner share passes through that owner will to the heirs.
Joint tenants hold equal undivided interests, and each has the right to possess the whole property rather than a divided part.
A joint tenancy can be created by oral agreement alone with no writing of any kind.
Joint tenants acquire their interests at different times and by different deeds as a matter of course.

questions.explanation: Survivorship changes who can sell after a death, so a broker must recognize a joint tenancy before assuming an estate or an heir must join in a listing. The statement that holds here is that joint tenants hold equal undivided interests, and each has the right to possess the whole property rather than a divided part.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes a void contract contrasted with a voidable contract?

answers.text: A voidable contract is a nullity that no party may enforce for any purpose.
A minor contract is the classic voidable contract, because the minor may disaffirm while the adult party remains bound.
A void contract may be ratified by the parties later and become fully valid.
A contract is voidable whenever either party simply regrets the bargain.

questions.explanation: The distinction decides whether a deal can be rescued by ratification or is dead on arrival, a judgment brokers must make before reassuring a client. The statement that holds here is that a minor contract is the classic voidable contract, because the minor may disaffirm while the adult party remains bound.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes fair housing testing and enforcement?

answers.text: Testing is entrapment and its results can never be used in enforcement.
A broker who treats every customer alike has the same risk as one who does not.
Enforcement of the Act is limited to warning letters with no damages available.
Complaints under the federal Act may be filed with the housing agency within the stated period, or a suit may be brought in court within its longer period.

questions.explanation: Every showing may be a test, which is another way of saying the only safe practice is the lawful practice with every customer. The statement that holds here is that complaints under the federal Act may be filed with the housing agency within the stated period, or a suit may be brought in court within its longer period.

questions.question: Which of these statements best sums up the Mississippi property condition disclosure form?

answers.text: The broker completes the disclosure form from the broker own inspection and signs it as the seller.
The disclosure form is a part of the purchase contract and amends its terms.
The disclosure form guarantees the condition of the property to the buyer.
The disclosure form is not part of the contract, although it is attached to the listing, a distinction the state outline states expressly.

questions.explanation: Form, author, and legal effect are the three facts candidates must hold together, because the outline tests each of them separately. The statement that holds here is that the disclosure form is not part of the contract, although it is attached to the listing, a distinction the state outline states expressly.

questions.question: When it comes to spot zoning that singles out one parcel, which statement holds up?

answers.text: A rezoning is spot zoning only when the parcel is larger than the surrounding district.
Spot zoning refers to the spots a surveyor marks on a plat before recording.
Courts may strike down spot zoning when it benefits one owner at the expense of the area without a basis in the comprehensive plan.
Spot zoning is always valid because zoning decisions can never be reviewed by a court.

questions.explanation: A seller touting a recent one-parcel rezoning may be selling a lawsuit risk, so brokers ask whether the change fits the plan before repeating the claim. The statement that holds here is that courts may strike down spot zoning when it benefits one owner at the expense of the area without a basis in the comprehensive plan.

questions.question: At a study session on actual notice contrasted with inquiry notice of title, which statement on the slides is correct?

answers.text: A buyer may ignore a stranger possession of the property and still take free of that person rights in every case.
Notice doctrines apply only to personal property and never affect real estate priorities.
Actual notice means a person in fact knows of a prior claim or transfer, while inquiry notice arises from facts that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate.
Inquiry notice requires a written letter delivered by the prior claimant to the buyer.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: Possession is the oldest title warning there is, and a broker showing occupied land a seller calls vacant should ask the notice question before writing an offer. The statement that holds here is that actual notice means a person in fact knows of a prior claim or transfer, while inquiry notice arises from facts that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate.

questions.question: Stay with the published framework. Which statement about required terms in a definite listing agreement is correct?

answers.text: A listing agreement may lawfully omit any termination date and run until the broker releases it.
A listing need not state the commission, because custom fixes it later.
A listing may describe the property by the owner nickname for it without a legal description in every case.
A definite listing agreement states a definite termination date, so the agency does not run indefinitely.

questions.explanation: Definiteness is consumer protection, and brokers who write complete listings avoid the argument that the parties never agreed on the essentials. The statement that holds here is that a definite listing agreement states a definite termination date, so the agency does not run indefinitely.

questions.question: In a briefing on an automated valuation model contrasted with an appraisal, which statement by the supervisor is correct?

answers.text: Automated models are always more accurate than an appraiser analysis.
An automated valuation model estimates value by statistical analysis of data without an appraiser inspection of the property.
An automated valuation model may set the legal value for tax purposes in every case.
An automated valuation model includes a full interior inspection by a certified appraiser.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: Online estimates shape seller expectations, so brokers explain what a model cannot see before the estimate becomes the listing argument. The statement that holds here is that an automated valuation model estimates value by statistical analysis of data without an appraiser inspection of the property.

questions.question: Test each statement for accuracy. Which statement about office policy manuals and consistent procedures is correct?

answers.text: A policy manual replaces the need for the broker to review any transaction.
A written office policy manual states the firm rules for agency, advertising, fair housing, trust funds, and document handling.
Policies may be kept secret from licensees to preserve flexibility.
A firm is safer with no written policies because nothing can be violated.

questions.explanation: Written standards turn supervision from personality into system, which is what a growing brokerage needs before it needs it desperately. The statement that holds here is that a written office policy manual states the firm rules for agency, advertising, fair housing, trust funds, and document handling.

questions.question: Which statement gives the most accurate picture of the Mississippi license law as the broker governing framework?

answers.text: The license law is a set of suggestions that brokers may follow voluntarily.
A private agreement may waive the license law duties a broker owes the public.
The license law governs only the Commission staff and not practicing brokers.
Where the license law and a private contract conflict, the law controls, because parties cannot contract around licensing duties.

questions.explanation: Every state topic in this bank hangs on this framework, and candidates who see the law as the source can reason through facts they have never seen. The statement that holds here is that where the license law and a private contract conflict, the law controls, because parties cannot contract around licensing duties.

questions.question: One option fits the principle best. Which statement about an easement created by prescription through long use is correct?

answers.text: An easement by prescription requires a written grant signed by the servient owner.
Use that the owner expressly permitted can still become prescriptive if it lasts long enough.
An easement by prescription arises from use of another land that is open, continuous, and adverse for the period the law requires.
A prescriptive easement gives the user fee title to the strip being used.

questions.explanation: Long-used paths and drives are classic prescriptive claims, and a broker who spots the use pattern can warn a buyer before a quiet dispute becomes a lawsuit. The statement that holds here is that an easement by prescription arises from use of another land that is open, continuous, and adverse for the period the law requires.

questions.question: Work through this item carefully. Which statement about counteroffer handling and the return to offeror status is correct?

answers.text: Accepting a counteroffer is unnecessary because a signed counter binds both parties at once.
A counteroffer keeps the original offer alive so both may be accepted by the seller.
A counteroffer may be accepted orally in every case even for a land contract.
When a seller changes any term of an offer and signs it, the change is a counteroffer that the original offeror may accept, reject, or counter again.

questions.explanation: Negotiations die on sloppy counter handling, so brokers track who holds the power of acceptance and when it lapses at every step. The statement that holds here is that when a seller changes any term of an offer and signs it, the change is a counteroffer that the original offeror may accept, reject, or counter again.

questions.question: Reason it out step by step. Which of the following statements about a variance granted for an unnecessary hardship is NOT correct?

answers.text: A variance runs with the land when granted, so a buyer of the property generally takes the benefit of an existing variance.
A variance is permission to depart from a zoning requirement when strict compliance would impose an unnecessary hardship on the owner.
An area variance relaxes a dimensional rule such as a setback, while a use variance allows a use the ordinance does not permit in the district.
A variance is a permanent change of the zoning classification of the parcel to a new district.

questions.explanation: Buyers price land on what they may build, so a broker must verify whether a variance exists and what it actually allows instead of repeating a seller assurance. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that a variance is a permanent change of the zoning classification of the parcel to a new district.

questions.question: Weigh the four options carefully. Which of the following statements about discount points paid to buy down a rate is NOT correct?

answers.text: A discount point is a penalty charged when a borrower pays a loan off early.
Whether the buyer or the seller pays points is a negotiable contract term that must be written into the agreement.
A discount point is prepaid interest paid at closing to reduce the interest rate on the loan.
Paying points makes sense only when the borrower keeps the loan long enough for the lower payment to repay the upfront cost.

questions.explanation: Points trade money today for money monthly, and brokers help clients run the break-even instead of treating points as an automatic bargain. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that a discount point is a penalty charged when a borrower pays a loan off early.

questions.question: While preparing for the exam, a candidate reviews budgeting and reporting for an income property owner. Which statement reflects the correct position?

answers.text: An owner is entitled to reports only when the property loses money.
Vacancy loss is not part of professional income reporting.
An operating budget and a bank statement are the same document.
An operating budget projects income and expenses for the property so the owner can judge performance against a plan.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: Owners renew managers who report clearly, and the budget conversation is where management proves it is a financial service and not a rent collection errand. The statement that holds here is that an operating budget projects income and expenses for the property so the owner can judge performance against a plan.

questions.question: Think about what the candidate must know. Which statement about broker supervision of associated licensees in Mississippi is correct?

answers.text: A Mississippi broker is responsible for supervising the associated licensees who practice under the broker license.
An associate works free of broker supervision once the associate has experience.
Supervision is satisfied by the broker being licensed, whatever the associates do.
A broker supervises only the transactions the broker personally negotiates.

questions.explanation: Supervision is the broker license in action, and candidates should read every associate duty in this bank as a broker duty to teach and enforce it. The statement that holds here is that a Mississippi broker is responsible for supervising the associated licensees who practice under the broker license.

questions.question: A trainee reads a summary of termination of agency by operation of law and asks a senior specialist to check it. Which statement in the summary is accurate?

answers.text: An agent may keep acting after learning of the principal death if a buyer is ready.
Termination by operation of law requires a written notice signed by both parties.
Agency terminates by operation of law on events such as the death or incapacity of the principal or the agent, or destruction of the subject property.
Agency continues unchanged after the principal death until the listing expires.

questions.explanation: In practice, accuracy matters: Authority can end without anyone signing anything, so a broker who learns of a death or a casualty loss must stop and verify authority before acting further. The statement that holds here is that agency terminates by operation of law on events such as the death or incapacity of the principal or the agent, or destruction of the subject property.

questions.question: Apply the standard approach here. Which of the following statements about the customer contrasted with the client in brokerage is NOT correct?

answers.text: A customer can become a client when the parties enter an agency agreement, which should be documented when it happens.
A client is a party who has engaged the broker in an agency relationship, while a customer is a party the broker works with without representing.
A broker owes a customer honesty and disclosure of material facts, but not the fiduciary duties owed to a client.
A customer is owed the same fiduciary duties as a client in every respect.

questions.explanation: Status decides duties, so brokers who sort out client from customer at first contact give each party exactly the service the law requires. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that a customer is owed the same fiduciary duties as a client in every respect.

questions.question: Keep the level and the task in view. Which of the following statements about the closing or settlement of a real estate sale is NOT correct?

answers.text: A closing may be handled in escrow by a neutral third party who performs the contract instructions when all conditions are met.
Closing is the completion of a real estate sale, when the deed is delivered, funds are disbursed, and title passes under the contract.
Closing occurs when the purchase contract is signed, before any performance.
At closing the parties perform the contract: the seller conveys, the buyer pays, and the settlement agent accounts for every dollar.

questions.explanation: Everything a broker does aims at this table, so understanding who performs what at closing keeps last day surprises from becoming failures. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that closing occurs when the purchase contract is signed, before any performance.

questions.question: Use the concept, not a guess. Which of the following statements about the homestead protection claimed on a principal residence is NOT correct?

answers.text: Homestead protection makes a home completely immune from every creditor, lien, and tax claim.
The protection attaches to the home the owner actually occupies as a principal residence, not to investment property the owner never occupies.
A homestead protection shelters a stated measure of equity in a principal residence from the claims of certain creditors.
Homestead protection generally does not defeat a mortgage the owner voluntarily granted, tax liens, or a mechanic lien for work on the home itself.

questions.explanation: Sellers in financial distress ask brokers about homestead protection, and overstating it can lead a client to ignore liens that will in fact reach the sale proceeds. The statement that does NOT hold — the one this item asks for — is the claim that homestead protection makes a home completely immune from every creditor, lien, and tax claim.

comptia-server-plus.quiz_title: CompTIA Server+ Exam Prep FREE Sample Exam

questions.question: Which of the following is true regarding understanding front-to-back airflow in rack servers?

answers.text: Most rack servers move air from back to front to blow hot air into the cold aisle.
Most rack servers move air from the front of the chassis to the back, which aligns with hot-aisle and cold-aisle data center layouts.
Rack servers have no defined airflow direction because fans blow randomly.
Front-to-back airflow means cables must block the front panel to keep air inside.

questions.explanation: Consistent airflow direction lets facilities supply cool air at the front and exhaust warm air at the rear.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes sandboxing concept?

answers.text: Sandboxing runs an application in an isolated environment that limits what it can access, containing damage if the application is compromised or misbehaves.
Sandboxing permanently patches vulnerabilities inside the application code itself.
Sandboxing is a backup method that copies virtual machines to removable media.
Sandboxing gives an application unrestricted access to the entire host file system.

questions.explanation: Isolation boundaries mean a failure inside the sandbox has fewer ways to reach the wider system.

questions.question: A colleague is unsure about loopback plug use. Which statement gives the right idea?

answers.text: A loopback plug measures the length of a cable and locates a break in it.
A loopback plug redirects a ports transmit signal back to its receive side, letting a technician test the port itself without a network connection.
A loopback plug boosts a weak signal so a marginal cable passes testing.
A loopback plug traces a cable run through walls back to the patch panel.

questions.explanation: If the port passes with a loopback plug, the port hardware works and suspicion moves to the cable or far end.

questions.question: Select the accurate statement about virtual ip for highly available services.

answers.text: A virtual IP address is the hardware address used to reserve a DHCP lease.
A virtual IP address is a text record that clients read to verify a domain.
A virtual IP address belongs permanently to one node and can never move or be shared.
A virtual IP address is a shared address associated with a clustered or load balanced service that clients connect to, rather than the address of one specific node.

questions.explanation: Clients see one stable address while the underlying node providing the service can change behind it.

questions.question: Select the accurate statement about purpose of the power-on self-test.

answers.text: The power-on self-test defragments the system drive before the operating system starts.
The power-on self-test is a built-in hardware check the system runs at startup to test core components such as the processor, memory, and controllers before the operating system loads.
The power-on self-test is a user-run application that benchmarks performance under load.
The self-test only checks the network connection and runs after the operating system has fully loaded.

questions.explanation: Because the self-test runs before the operating system, its failures point squarely at hardware.

questions.question: A study group briefing turns to understanding cat8 copper cabling characteristics. Which point is correct?

answers.text: Cat8 cabling is intended for the longest possible building runs at the lowest available speeds.
Cat8 cabling cannot be shielded and must be installed without any connectors.
Cat8 cabling is a wireless standard that uses radio waves instead of copper conductors.
Cat8 shielded cabling is designed for high-speed data center links, including the fastest short-reach copper Ethernet speeds, over shorter distances than Cat6a.

questions.explanation: Short, shielded, high-bandwidth copper links suit switch-to-server connections inside a data center row.

questions.question: Select the accurate statement about hardware lifecycle stages from procurement to disposal.

answers.text: The hardware lifecycle moves through procurement, deployment, operation and maintenance, and finally retirement and disposal, with records updated at each stage.
Retirement and disposal happen before deployment in a correctly managed lifecycle.
Hardware lifecycle stages apply only to software and never to physical equipment.
The hardware lifecycle ends at procurement, with no stages for operation or retirement.

questions.explanation: Managing every stage ensures equipment is supported while in service and is removed and recorded properly at the end.

questions.question: A study group briefing turns to identifying environmental or infrastructure changes. Which point is correct?

answers.text: Infrastructure changes should only be considered after every internal component has been replaced.
Environmental changes never affect servers, so power and cooling history can safely be ignored during identification.
Identifying the problem includes checking for environmental or infrastructure changes such as power work, cooling changes, or network alterations that could explain the failure.
If a change occurred in the building, it should be treated as the proven cause without any testing.

questions.explanation: Servers depend on power, cooling, and connectivity, so a recent change in any of them belongs on the list of suspects.

questions.question: Pick the statement that correctly states how understanding raid 1 mirroring is understood in server administration.

answers.text: RAID 1 mirrors identical copies of data on paired drives, so the array continues operating when one mirrored drive fails.
RAID 1 stripes data with no copies, so one drive failure destroys the entire array.
RAID 1 stores data only once and relies on a tape backup for any drive failure.
RAID 1 uses two parity drives to protect data spread across many data drives.

questions.explanation: Mirroring is simple and fast to recover because the surviving drive already holds a complete copy.

questions.question: A study group briefing turns to using maintenance windows for server updates. Which point is correct?

answers.text: Maintenance windows eliminate the need to notify users about possible disruption.
A maintenance window is a hardware setting that blocks all network traffic permanently.
A maintenance window is a planned period of reduced business impact during which updates and restarts can be applied to servers.
A maintenance window is a period when updates must be applied at peak usage time.

questions.explanation: Scheduling disruptive work in an agreed window balances the need for updates against service availability.

questions.question: A colleague is unsure about monitoring backup jobs and alerting on failures. Which statement gives the right idea?

answers.text: Monitoring backups means watching the tape drive lights while a job is running.
Backup jobs should be monitored daily with alerts on failures or missed schedules, because a silently failing job can leave days or weeks without a recoverable copy.
Backup failures are harmless as long as the job is scheduled to run again next month.
A failed backup job automatically creates a successful copy somewhere else.

questions.explanation: Prompt attention to a failed job keeps the gap in protection short instead of discovering it during a restore.

questions.question: Which description of routing table inspection matches accepted server administration practice?

answers.text: The routing table repairs itself whenever a destination becomes unreachable.
The routing table lists listening ports and the processes that own them.
Reading a hosts routing table confirms which interface and gateway it will use for a destination, revealing missing or misleading routes.
The routing table shows which users are currently signed in to the server.

questions.explanation: Traffic follows the table, so an unexpected entry explains why packets take a wrong or dead end path.

questions.question: On a written exercise, a question covers handling unsigned drivers during setup. Which statement is the correct one?

answers.text: An unsigned driver should be treated with caution during setup because its publisher and integrity cannot be verified in the usual way.
An unsigned driver warning means the hardware itself is physically damaged.
Unsigned drivers should be installed automatically without any review or testing.
Unsigned drivers are always safer than signed drivers for production servers.

questions.explanation: Lack of a signature removes an important trust check, so extra validation and testing are warranted before use.

questions.question: Which description of locked server racks restricting physical access to hardware matches accepted server administration practice?

answers.text: Locking a rack door disables the servers inside it until an administrator restarts them remotely.
A locked rack protects a server from network attacks and malware arriving over its network connection.
Locked racks are unnecessary because anyone inside a server room can be fully trusted with every system.
Locked server racks prevent unauthorized people from removing drives, pressing power controls, or disconnecting cables even after they have entered the server room.

questions.explanation: Rack locks add a second physical barrier inside the room, so room access alone does not grant hands-on access to hardware.

questions.question: A server administrator is asked about understanding redundant power supplies for availability. Which response is accurate?

answers.text: Redundant power supplies double the voltage delivered to the motherboard at all times.
Redundant power supplies exist only to make the server louder during operation.
If one redundant power supply fails, the server always shuts down immediately.
Redundant power supplies allow a server to keep running if one supply fails, because the remaining supply can carry the load.

questions.explanation: Duplicating the supply removes a single point of failure from the power path inside the server.

questions.question: On a written exercise, a question covers conditional statements in administrative scripts. Which statement is the correct one?

answers.text: A conditional statement deletes the script itself whenever its condition evaluates to true.
A conditional statement lets a script choose different actions based on whether a condition is true, such as installing an update only when it is missing.
A conditional statement repeats commands endlessly with no way to check a condition.
A conditional statement forces the same action to run regardless of any test result.

questions.explanation: Conditionals give scripts decision-making ability, so they can respond appropriately to different states on different systems.

questions.question: In a systems administration team review, the topic of replacing a failed drive with a hot spare comes up. Which statement is correct?

answers.text: When a hot spare exists, the failed drive should be removed and discarded before checking rebuild status.
A hot spare stores a permanent copy of all data at all times and needs no rebuild after a failure.
A hot spare must be formatted by the operating system before the controller can ever use it.

When a hot spare is present, the controller automatically begins rebuilding data onto the spare after a member fails, and the administrator should verify that the rebuild has started and is progressing.

questions.explanation: The spare only becomes a full member through the rebuild process, so verifying rebuild progress confirms redundancy is being restored.

questions.question: On a written exercise, a question covers least connections load balancing. Which statement is the correct one?

answers.text: Least connections load balancing sends a new request to the server in the pool that currently has the fewest active connections.
Least connections sends requests to servers in a fixed repeating circular sequence.
Least connections always selects the server that joined the pool most recently.
Least connections ignores current load and assigns requests completely at random.

questions.explanation: Directing work toward the least busy member helps balance uneven request durations across the pool.

questions.question: A junior administrator is unsure about starting performance troubleshooting with a baseline. Which statement should the senior administrator confirm?

answers.text: Performance troubleshooting is more reliable when current measurements are compared against a baseline from normal operation, because the comparison shows which resource actually changed.
Performance can only be judged by how the server feels to a single user at one moment.
Baselines must be taken during the worst incident to represent normal operation accurately.
A baseline is unnecessary because any high reading automatically identifies the faulty component.

questions.explanation: Without a normal reference point, an administrator cannot tell abnormal pressure from the server ordinary workload pattern.

questions.question: A colleague is unsure about principle of least privilege. Which statement gives the right idea?

answers.text: Least privilege grants each user and process only the access needed to perform its job and nothing more, limiting damage if an account is misused.
Least privilege means denying users the access they need to complete assigned tasks.
Least privilege requires all users to share one highly privileged account for daily work.
Least privilege gives administrators permanent full access to every system for convenience.
